title: Revelation 16:12 — the Euphrates dried up for the kings from the east
summary: Revelation 16:12 in English with Greek reference header: the sixth angel pours out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, its water is dried up, and the way is prepared for the kings from the east.

text.text: 12 The sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates; and its water was dried up, so that the way would be prepared for the kings from the east.

numbers.note: the sixth angel poured out his bowl
